تستحجبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْجِبُوا (tastaḥjibū) /tas.taħ.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# تُسْتَحْجَبُوا (tustaḥjabū) /tus.taħ.d͡ʒa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
